analysis.why_invest: Micron makes memory chips (DRAM and NAND) used in data centers, AI servers, phones, PCs and cars. The shares trade on a forward P/E of 3.7 versus a sector median of 16.4, and 45 analysts have an average target of $1,561.91, about 100% above the current price. analysis.thesis: Micron is showing exceptional growth, margins and returns, and it looks very cheap against its sector on earnings.
